import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03
2024-01-01,04:00,Tea,Small,5.22,1,Credit Card,18-24,1,5.22
2024-01-01,06:00,Latte,Large,6.37,2,Credit Card,45-54,1,12.74
2024-01-01,08:00,Americano,Medium,7.07,3,Cash,45-54,1,21.21
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Combine date and time into a single datetime object and extract the hour
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour

# --- Visualization ---
# Set a professional and modern theme
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 14))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard (2024-01-01)', fontsize=24, weight='bold', y=0.98)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Horizontal Bar Chart)
sales_by_product = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sales_by_product.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(sales_by_product)))
ax1.set_title('Total Sales Revenue by Product', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=12)
# Add data labels to the bars
for index, value in enumerate(sales_by_product):
    ax1.text(value, index, f' ${value:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=11)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (Bar Chart)
age_order = sorted(df['customer_age_group'].unique(), key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0].replace('+', '')))
sales_by_age = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.barplot(x=sales_by_age.index, y=sales_by_age.values, ax=ax2, palette="magma")
ax2.set_title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
for p in ax2.patches:
    ax2.annotate(f'${p.get_height():.2f}', (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                 ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='black', xytext=(0, 5),
                 textcoords='offset points')
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# 3. Sales Trend by Hour (Line Plot)
sales_by_hour = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
sns.lineplot(x=sales_by_hour.index, y=sales_by_hour.values, ax=ax3, marker='o', markersize=10, lw=3, color=sns.color_palette("rocket")[2])
ax3.set_title('Hourly Sales Trend', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of the Day (24h)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_xticks(sales_by_hour.index)
ax3.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# 4. Payment Method Distribution (Donut Chart)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
colors = sns.color_palette("plasma", len(payment_counts))
ax4.pie(payment_counts, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=140, colors=colors,
        wedgeprops=dict(width=0.4, edgecolor='w'), textprops={'fontsize': 12, 'weight': 'bold'})
ax4.set_title('Transaction Count by Payment Method', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
ax4.axis('equal')

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
